correctness.rationale: Classify all geodesically convex proper sets on unweighted cycles as unique short cyclic intervals; prove iff triple gap criterion, exclude four-point supports using 2n <= 4L contradiction, count triple compositions, and construct online threshold-tree. The executable independently checks all-pairs shortest paths (n<=13), all supports (n<=17), online recursion (n<=15), and constructive online certificates (n<=100). Finite checks supplement, not replace, all-order proof.
